articles.title: Claude helps recover $395,000 in bitcoin trapped on a computer for years
articles.snippet: The owner had been trying for eight weeks to brute-force the password on their current Blockchain.com wallet, testing roughly 3.5 trillion combinations using the btcrecover service on a rented computing chip.

articles.title: XRP whale wallets hit all-time highs: Will it push price above $1.50?
articles.snippet: XRP whales are accumulating at record levels, increasing the chances of XRP price rise toward $2, fueled by growing XRPL activity and a bullish technical setup.

articles.title: Wall Street’s tokenization boom has a liquidity problem: Axis CEO
articles.snippet: As RWAs cross $32 billion and JPMorgan files for a new tokenized fund, Axis CEO Chris Kim argues that the industry is celebrating the wrong milestone.

articles.title: Trump’s White House weighs 250 pardons to celebrate America's 250th birthday
articles.snippet: One of the developers behind the crypto-mixing protocol Samourai Wallet has publicly expressed hopes for a pardon, along with FTX founder Sam Bankman-Fried.

articles.title: Bitcoin Owner Claims Claude AI Cracked Lost Wallet Password, Netting $400K in BTC
articles.snippet: A viral thread on X drew millions of views as a user claimed Claude AI helped recover a lost Bitcoin wallet.
